searchText: Perhaps we should prefix all upgrades in execution-specs/network-upgrades /mainnet-upgrades with the upgrade number, like 01-homestead, 02-dao-fork and so on? Or add a meta doc describing the order of upgrades. Right now you have to know the sequence of historical upgrades by heart.

excerpts.author: yperbasis
excerpts.content:
Perhaps we should prefix all upgrades in execution-specs/network-upgrades
/mainnet-upgrades with the upgrade number, like 01-homestead, 02-dao-fork and so on? Or add a meta doc describing the order of upgrades. Right now you have to know the sequence of historical upgrades by heart.
